scope: Single pre-specified strict before-after stroke-care synthesis

analyses.outcome_group: Odds of receiving endovascular thrombectomy during the COVID-19 pandemic

rules: Select one report-level contrast with explicit EVT event and cohort counts for COVID-19 and a pre-pandemic reference period.
The denominator may be an acute-stroke or ischemic-stroke cohort only when that cohort is expressly defined by the primary report.
Do not use review forest estimates, percentage-only values, or a contrast lacking both group totals.

method_selection_policy: After identifying eligible independent evidence, select and justify a synthesis approach from the study data. The participant package does not prescribe a computation method.
